body:
New PACKET_FIND_MATCH/PACKET_MATCH_FOUND. Server holds queue until 7 real players (MATCHMAKING_MAX_QUEUE, correcting for slot-0's pre-existing non-network status) or 20s timeout, then bot-fills via existing bot_think and starts a fresh match. Live-verified over real loopback UDP: solo timeout-triggered bot-fill and 7-way immediate queue-full, both confirmed via real concurrent probe processes seeing their own entity in the resulting 8-entity snapshot. Commit a6c8226. Phase 2 (client portal trigger) is next.

⚓ ☃
title: S248-01 shipped: real server-side matchmaking queue (BP-LOBBY-001 Phase 1)
